name: Idle
overview: Scripture warns against idleness by illustrating the consequences of slothfulness and unproductive behavior. Proverbs highlights the value of diligence and warns that idle hands and slothfulness lead to poverty, hunger, and wasted potential, as seen in the examples of the ant's industriousness and the vineyard of the slothful. Idle talk and idle words are also cautioned against, as they bring no profit and tend toward penury. Together, these verses emphasize the importance of purposeful labor and wise use of time to honor God and avoid the pitfalls of idleness.
